_comment: Copy to <toolsdir>\hc-config.json and fill in the real UUIDs. NEVER commit the filled copy: this repo is public and a ping URL is a capability URL.
_LogPattern_comment: Scope the watch to ONE batch's logs, so a foreign batch's final sentinel cannot latch completion and blind stall detection. Real log directories hold hagrid.log, dozens of rotated hagrid-<date>-N.log(.gz), and *.console.log from unrelated batches, so the wide default '*.log' is NOT reliably the sweep's driver log - install_heartbeat_task.ps1 refuses to install with '*.log' unless exactly one file in LogDir matches it right now. Narrow this to the actual driver log's naming pattern, e.g. 'stepB_*.log'.
